description: Pre-merge PR review triggers the five-axis review with severity labeling
input: Review this PR before merge: it adds a new REST endpoint that writes to the orders table.
expect: Review across correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance; label every finding with a severity (Critical / Nit / Consider / FYI) and end with a verdict.
assertions: covers all five axes (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance)
checks input validation and SQL parameterization
ends with an explicit Approve / Request changes verdict

description: Oversized change — 1000+ line PR must be flagged and split requested
input: Please review my 1,200-line PR that refactors auth, adds a new feature, and changes the DB schema.
expect: Flag the change as too large to review properly, note it mixes refactor with feature work, and request a split.
assertions: points out refactoring and feature work are two changes

description: Secrets or injection in the diff block the merge as Critical
input: Review this diff: an API key is hardcoded and a SQL query is built by string concatenation with user input.
expect: Classify both as Critical severity (security vulnerability), block the merge, and demand fixes.
assertions: flags the hardcoded secret as Critical
flags string-concatenated SQL as an injection vulnerability
proposes the remedy (parameterized query, secrets out of code)

description: Bug-fix PR without a regression test is a red flag the reviewer must push back on
input: Review this bug fix for the checkout payment bug. The PR only changes the payment service code, no tests.
expect: Review both the fix and the absence of a regression test; flag missing regression coverage as a required change.
assertions: lists missing regression tests as a red flag

description: Dead-code hygiene after a refactor — identify and ask before deleting
input: After my refactor, is there any dead code I should clean up? I replaced formatLegacyDate with formatDate.
expect: Identify the now-unreachable formatLegacyDate and any orphaned references, list them explicitly, and ask before deleting rather than silently removing.

description: Near-miss negative — writing new code from scratch is not a review request
input: Write a function that validates an email address and returns a normalized version.
expect: Do not trigger the review framework — this is feature authoring with no existing change to review.
assertions: does not run the five-axis review

description: Near-miss negative — explaining code is not a pre-merge review
input: Can you explain what this existing function does step by step? I'm trying to understand the codebase.
expect: Do not trigger pre-merge review — an explanation request is not a review of a change.
assertions: does not produce a review verdict
